sovereign_country.strategic_role: 西欧核心消费市场、高客单价品牌合规与本土清关

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Offshore Building Information Modeling (BIM) and Structural Drafting

meta_jurisdiction_context.jurisdiction_name_en: France (unitary national jurisdiction; no sub-state corporate registry distinction)
meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Civil Law (Napoleonic codified system; Code civil, Code de commerce, Code monétaire et financier)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: Treaty on the Functioning of the European Union, Articles 49 and 63 (freedom of establishment and free movement of capital) — applicable to EU/EEA shareholders
Network of approximately 103 French bilateral investment treaties (BITs) — the exact treaty to be identified after UBO nationality piercing
Network of approximately 150 double taxation avoidance agreements (DTAAs) — governing withholding and profit allocation based on the ultimate beneficial owner's tax residence
Convention on the Recognition and Enforcement of Foreign Arbitral Awards (New York, 1958) — applicable to treaty-based investor-state disputes
Hague Convention of 5 October 1961 abolishing the Requirement of Legalisation for Foreign Public Documents (Apostille Convention) — applicable to the authentication bundle

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Code monétaire et financier, Book V, Title VI, Articles L561-1 to L561-50 (AML/CFT obligations and beneficial owner register), as amended by Loi n° 2016-1691 du 9 décembre 2016 (Loi Sapin II) and Ordonnance n° 2016-1635 du 1er décembre 2016; implementing decree: Décret n° 2018-284 du 18 avril 2018. Register mechanics: Code de commerce, Articles L123-1 et seq. and R123-166-1 et seq. (filing of the 'bénéficiaires effectifs' declaration to the RCS through the INPI Guichet unique). EU convergence: Directive (EU) 2015/849, Directive (EU) 2018/843, Directive (EU) 2019/1151, and the post-2024 package — Regulation (EU) 2024/1624 (AMLR) and Regulation (EU) 2024/1620 (AMLA) with phased application from 2027. Case law: Conseil d'État (2020) and CJEU Joined Cases C-37/20 and C-601/20 restrict general-public access to the French UBO register; access is limited to supervisory authorities, TRACFIN, and obliged entities acting under client due diligence with a legitimate interest.

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of the corporate extract (extrait du registre des sociétés) of each corporate shareholder and, if any, each corporate UBO above 25%
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Official company registry of the corporate shareholder's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (state party to the 1961 Convention) OR Consular Legalization (non-party state), followed by certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Original or certified power of attorney (pouvoir) authorizing the French incorporator or signatory to execute the articles of association
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary and/or consular authority of the shareholder's country of execution
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille or Consular Legalization, with certified French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copies of valid passports or national identity cards of the manager (gérant) and all natural-person beneficial owners
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Competent national authority issuing the identity document in the country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Sworn translation by an expert-traducteur registered with a French Cour d'appel; no apostille required where document authenticity is certified by the issuing authority

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Manager's declaration of non-conviction and eligibility (déclaration de non-condamnation) and, where requested by the bank or registrar, an extract of the criminal record (bulletin n°2 or foreign equivalent)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: French casier judiciaire national, or competent judicial authority of the manager's country of residence
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille for foreign criminal records, plus sworn French translation

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Proof of registered office address (justificatif de domiciliation or justificatif de jouissance des locaux) or approved domiciliation agreement
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Owner of the premises, lessor, or approved domiciliation company (société de domiciliation agréée)
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Private instrument accepted in the formation dossier; notarization and apostille not required under French law

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: All managers, shareholders at or above the 25% threshold, and authorized signatories must be screened pre-incorporation and continuously thereafter against: (i) the EU consolidated sanctions list (Regulation (EU) 269/2014 and associated asset-freeze regimes); (ii) the UN Security Council consolidated list; (iii) the US OFAC SDN list — required for USD-denominated transfers and for the Wire Transfer and Wise payment rails; (iv) the French DG Trésor asset-freeze measures (gels des avoirs, Articles L562-1 et seq. CMF); and (v) FATF and EU lists of high-risk third jurisdictions. PEP status is assessed under Article L561-10 CMF and FATF Recommendations 12 and 22; enhanced due diligence, senior-management approval, and source-of-funds evidence are mandatory for PEPs and for any ownership chain passing through trusts, foundations, or offshore financial centres. Screening results must be documented and retained for five years; any positive hit or inconsistent ownership chart is escalated internally, and a TRACFIN declaration is filed where suspicion is confirmed.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: INPI 'Le Guichet unique' (the post-2023 national single electronic window) — https://guichet-unique.inpi.fr; de facto name availability checked against the INPI-RCS database (data.inpi.fr) and the Infogreffe national registry
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: All mandatory statutory filings must be made in French. The dénomination sociale (company name) may be registered in French or in a modern foreign language, provided it is rendered in Latin/Roman characters for RCS purposes; non-Latin denominations must be accompanied by a French transliteration registered at the same time. The name must be lawful, non-misleading, distinct from pre-existing trademarks and existing RCS denominations, and consistent with the legal-form token 'SARL', which must follow the denomination.
prohibited_and_sensitive_tokens: Tokens denoting regulated financial or insurance activities ('Banque', 'Assurance', 'Mutuelle', 'Courtier', 'Société de financement') — prior authorization of the ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution) required
Tokens reserved for other legal forms ('SA', 'SAS', 'SCA', 'EURL') — prohibited where the registered form is a SARL, to avoid misleading the public
Tokens denoting regulated professions ('Avocat', 'Notaire', 'Expert-Comptable', 'Commissaire aux Comptes') — reserved by professional orders and prohibited absent a licence
Tokens with cooperative or mutual status ('Coopérative', 'Mutuelle à capital variable') — permitted only where the entity actually adopts that statutory form
National sovereign or misleading public-authority tokens ('France', 'République', 'National', 'État') — subject to administrative pre-screening and denial where the proposed use misleads the public
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: French statutory law does not establish a binding pre-incorporation name reservation mechanism; the effective name check occurs at the moment of formation filing through the INPI Guichet unique against the RCS and Sirene databases. The 30-day figure reflects the de facto re-filing window during which supporting documents remain valid and the INPI assistance team will process a corrected name submission. If the name is rejected: (i) technical or database-format refusals are corrected and re-filed via the same dossier within the INPI technical support window (15 working days); (ii) where rejection cites third-party trademark similarity, the applicant may submit evidence of earlier use and raise an opposition defence under Articles L712-2 and L713-3 of the Code de la propriété intellectuelle; (iii) where the registrar (greffier) refuses RCS registration, an appeal may be filed with the judge supervising the register (juge commis à la surveillance du registre du commerce et des sociétés) within one month of the refusal notification, per Article R123-92 of the Code de commerce; (iv) a final administrative refusal can be contested before the competent administrative or ordinary court, as applicable.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: Permitted for a SARL carrying out off-site CAD/BIM services, provided the registered office (siège social) is a real and permanent address in France supported by either (i) a domiciliation contract with an approved 'société de domiciliation agréée' under Décret n° 2021-1579 du 7 décembre 2021, or (ii) a lease or ownership title. A PO box alone does not satisfy the statutory requirement. The domiciliation contract must be filed with the RCS, cannot restrict the company's ability to receive official notifications, and for a non-regulated engineering services entity no prefecture approval is required.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low-to-moderate: cumulative probability of approximately 10-15% within the first three fiscal years for a standard-risk, licence-free engineering CAD outsourcing entity. Unannounced physical inspections are most likely during DGFiP tax audits (vérification de comptabilité), INSEE statistical controls, or compliance audits of the domiciliation company conducted under the applicable approval regime. DGCCRF consumer-protection inspections are rare absent client complaints. The registered office must nevertheless be able to receive legal process at all times.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Drafting of the articles of association (statuts) and legal and structuring advice for the SARL
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark; fixed professional fee, non-statutory

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Official RCS registration fee — inscription au registre du commerce et des sociétés filed via the INPI Guichet unique
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: INPI / greffe du tribunal de commerce
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory tariff of the greffes des tribunaux de commerce (Décret n° 82-9), approximately EUR 84-90

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Statutory public announcement (annonce légale) in a legal gazette approved by the préfecture
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutorily required under Code de commerce Article L210-2; published market tariff for SARL formation announcements

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered office — domiciliation agreement with an approved domiciliation company (first 12 months, Paris-region benchmark)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; EUR 80-120 per month all-inclusive for standard service contracts

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Sworn translations of foreign-language corporate and identity documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Expert-traducteur registered with a French Cour d'appel
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark; EUR 60-120 per document under the tariff practice of the Cour d'appel

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Apostille and/or consular legalization fees for the foreign authentication bundle
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Competent authority of the country of origin (Hague Convention) or the French consulate
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing statutory and consular tariffs; approximately USD 20-60 per document depending on the issuing state

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Name clearance and trademark pre-search across INPI, Infogreffe, and EUIPO databases
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Official search database fees plus legal counsel time at market rates

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: UBO declaration preparation and AML/KYC pre-filing compliance review
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market benchmark fixed fee for a standard-risk, single-layer ownership structure

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Optional notarial certification of powers of attorney or signatures (acte authentique)
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Not required for a cash-only SARL; fee applies only if foreign real-property contributions are made or optional notarization is elected

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Title III, Chapter III, Articles L.223-1 to L.223-43 and R.223-1 to R.223-24 (SARL).
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés); filing is made through the Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises.
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: M0 — Demande d'immatriculation au RCS (Cerfa n° 11678*04) submitted via formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr.
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital (minimum EUR 1); under Article L.223-7, cash contributions must be fully paid up at incorporation and deposited in a blocked bank account or with a notary until the company is registered.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED, that the subscribers, acting as the founding members of the [Company], hereby adopt the statutes and approve the formation process under Articles L.223-1 et seq. of the French Commercial Code. RESOLVED, that all cash contributions totalling EUR [amount] are subscribed and fully paid into the company's blocking account; the bank certificate will be filed. RESOLVED, that the registered office is established at [address], France. RESOLVED, that [Name] is appointed as gérant, with power to direct and administer the company, open bank accounts, sign on behalf of the company, and complete the registration filings.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Drafting and Legalization of French and English Constitutional Documents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Office of the appointed French corporate counsel; final filing via Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Engage a French corporate counsel to draft the statutes (statuts) in French and an English counterpart. Have the founder(s) initial every page and sign the final version. If the articles are executed before a notaire, the notaire authenticates them; if executed under private signature, no prior legalization is required but a certified translation is recommended for foreign records. Upload the signed statutes into the Guichet Unique preparatory package.
required_dossiers: Draft statutes (Articles of Association)
Founders' identification documents (passports or identity cards)
Declaration of no criminal conviction for the proposed gérant
Certified English translation of statutes (if requested by foreign partners)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Greffe asks for rectification of the statutes (e.g., missing registered office wording, invalid corporate object clause), refile an acte rectificatif through legal counsel and re-submit on Guichet Unique within 15 days.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Opening a Blocked Capital Deposit Account and Blocking Funds
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: French commercial bank or notaire (Caisse des Dépôts if required by the selected bank)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the société en formation and transfer the declared cash share capital. Obtain the bank's certificate of deposit (certificat de dépôt des fonds) showing that funds are unavailable until RCS registration. For any in-kind contribution, appoint a commissaire aux apports unless the statutory exemption applies.
required_dossiers: Pre-incorporation bank account opening agreement
Bank transfer of cash capital
Certificat de dépôt des fonds issued by the bank
Valuation report for any in-kind contribution (if applicable)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses certification due to KYC concerns, provide notarized source-of-funds evidence or switch to a notaire to hold the funds under the same rules.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of the Mandatory Legal Notice in a Journal d'Annonces Légales (JAL)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Any authorised legal announcement newspaper in the departmental jurisdiction of the registered office
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Contract with an approved local JAL publisher to publish the avis de constitution containing the proposed company name, legal form, capital amount, registered office address, corporate object and managers. The JAL delivers an attestation of publication that must be included in the M0 dossier.
required_dossiers: Legal notice draft signed by the founders
Proof of payment of publication fees
JAL attestation of publication (journal receipt)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL modifies the legal notice or the court rejects its form, re-publish with the required wording and obtain a corrected attestation.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Submission of the M0 Incorporation Dossier via Guichet Unique
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique des Formalités d'Entreprises (INSEE / Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log into formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr, identify as a société à responsabilité limitée, complete the M0 statutory form, and attach all constitutional documents, proof of deposit of capital, JAL attestation, registered office acceptance, manager's identity and declaration, and a power of attorney if filing is made by an agent. Submit for transmission to the Greffe and pay the applicable registration fees online.
required_dossiers: Form M0 (standard company registration)
Statutes signed by founders
Registered office domiciliation agreement or lease
Blocked funds deposit certificate
JAL publication receipt
Manager's identity and declaration of no convictions
Power of attorney (if filed by agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Upon a rejection decision from the Greffe, rectify omissions by lodging a re-completed dossier on Guichet Unique within the statutory timeline; respond to the verificateur's queries and re-pay or rebase the filing fees to avoid deletion of the file.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Register at RCS, Obtain Extrait Kbis, and Open Corporate Bank Accounts
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (RCS) and selected commercial bank
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: After approval, the Greffe issues the Extrait Kbis (registration certificate). Use the Kbis to unblock the deposited capital and transfer the funds to the company's active bank account. Register with DREETS if the first employees are recruited and subscribe the gérant to the applicable social security regime.
required_dossiers: Approved Kbis registration extract
Bank release order
Employer registration declaration if applicable
Social security declaration for the gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the Kbis shows an incorrect legal address or missing activities, file a modification application within one month to the Greffe to correct the RCS entry.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: None (professional services; not an industrial activity). No specific industrial licensing board is triggered by an ISIC 7110 CAD/BIM service activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: None. No manufacturing, assembly, or logistics permit is required for the BIM/CAD outsourcing business. General RCS registration and, if applicable, an office premises lease suffice.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Not applicable (no ICPE classified facility registered).
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt / Not required — no physical industrial plant or environmental impact.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: For a standard office lease: no process wastewater discharge, no VOC emissions, and no hazardous waste; only domestic sewage and municipal recycling obligations apply.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: For standard office use, the landlord provides the fire-safety classification and building access certificate. The company complies with French Labour Code Articles R.4214-1 et seq. relating to electrical installation safety, first-aid equipment, and workplace ergonomics.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via official portal impots.gouv.fr
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities must register a French SARL with guichet-entreprises.fr to obtain SIREN/SIRET. Subsequent DGFiP registration for tax identification number (TIN) and VAT number (FR + SIREN) requires submission of incorporation deed, articles of association, proof of registered office, and bank details. Annual declarations and tax returns filed electronically through the French tax portal.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: No check-the-box or hybrid mismatch elections available under French law. Classification fixed by legal form (SARL taxed at corporate level). Limited micro-BIC regime available for small businesses below turnover thresholds.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: Mandatory Facture Pro electronic invoicing for B2B transactions above €25,000 threshold. Real-time VAT reporting via PEPITES platform. Digital fiscal stamps and clearance integrated with customs procedures for cross-border supplies.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% TVA rate applies to goods physically exported outside the EU and services performed outside France for non-EU clients. Requires proof of export and non-EU destination.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Bill of Lading or CMR transport document
Inward Remittance Certificate or foreign client payment proof
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent zero-rating claims attract 40% penalty plus interest and possible criminal prosecution. Retrospective clawback of input VAT credits with five-year limitation period.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France maintains full capital account convertibility with no prior approval requirements for profit repatriation or capital movements. Current account transactions are unrestricted. Profit remittance from French SARL to foreign parent entities is permitted subject only to standard corporate governance, tax filing, and AML compliance.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No mandatory surrender or forced conversion of export proceeds applies under French law. Companies must retain supporting trade documentation and may file statistical declarations with the Banque de France for exports exceeding €50,000. No statutory conversion ratios or timelines are prescribed.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: High feasibility for regulated cross-border digital EMIs via platforms such as Wise and Revolut Business. Legal constraints include mandatory French AML/KYC adherence, FATCA/CRS reporting obligations, and restrictions on certain offshore digital wallet usage for corporate entities.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: Remote digital onboarding is fully permitted for French SARL entities through video identification and electronic KYC processes. Physical presence of directors is not mandatory for standard accounts but may be required for high-value or complex ownership structures.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Adverse media or sanctions screening alerts
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Bundle of beneficial ownership certificates, source-of-funds evidence, corporate registration documents, and director declarations

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Inconsistent beneficial ownership or director information
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Updated Articles of Association, notarized director identifications, and corporate resolution records

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Compliant inbound wires use SWIFT MT103 with purpose codes such as 'Investment in French entity' or 'Share capital contribution'. Verification requires matching bank references, corporate resolutions, beneficial ownership proof, and invoice documentation. All transactions subject to French AML reporting thresholds of €10,000.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade disbursements cleared via SWIFT MT103 or Commercial Letters of Credit. Correspondent banking networks used with full documentation including contracts, invoices, delivery proofs, and CAD outsourcing agreements. Purpose codes must align with service provision activities.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual statutory accounts filing (dépôt des comptes annuels) with management report and auditor's report if applicable
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce (Commercial Court Registry)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Within seven months after the financial year-end and within one month after shareholders' approval; approval must occur within six months of fiscal year-end
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Formal notice from the registry; court order to file; legal-entity fine up to EUR 7,500; persistent non-compliance after formal notice triggers administrative strike-off and potential judicial dissolution.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Corporation tax return (déclaration de résultats) and supporting schedules (Form No. 2065-SD and liasse fiscale)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) – Service des Impôts des Entreprises
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For calendar-year financial year-ends, by the second working day after 3 May; for off-calendar fiscal year-ends, no later than the third month after the closing date
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late-filing surcharge of 5% on tax payable plus monthly late interest of 0.20%; automatic tax assessment after formal notice; repeated non-filing exposes the entity to tax audit and administrative penalties.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Mandatory independent audit if the SARL exceeds at least two of three thresholds for two consecutive years: balance sheet total above EUR 4,000,000; net turnover above EUR 8,000,000; average workforce above 50 employees. Audit may also be required at the request of shareholders holding at least 10% of the share capital or where the company controls another entity.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général – PCG) under Articles L123-12 et seq. of the French Commercial Code; consolidated financial statements, if prepared, must use IFRS as adopted by the European Union.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: There is no standalone annual UBO filing in France. The SARL must file an initial declaration of beneficial owners with the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce within 30 days of incorporation and must update that declaration within 30 days of any transfer or change in shareholding that affects the identity of persons directly or indirectly holding more than 25% of capital or voting rights.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 260–900 per year for a standard registered-office/agent service outside Paris; premium Paris addresses may range from USD 1,100–1,500 per year.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 5,400–19,000 per year for a small SARL when a statutory audit is compulsory; no certified audit fee is incurred if the statutory thresholds are not met.

corporate_income_tax_regime.statutory_headline_rate: 25% standard corporate income tax rate (Art. 219 CGI); effective blended rate 25.8% when the 3.3% social contribution is triggered on tax exceeding €763,000.
corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Reduced 15% rate on the first €42,500 of taxable profit for qualifying SMEs (Art. 219 CGI conditions: turnover below €10M, fully paid-up share capital, at least 75% held by individuals, entity in existence for at least two full years); Research Tax Credit (CIR) up to 30% on qualifying R&D including eligible software and CAD/BIM innovation; Innovation Tax Credit (CII) up to 20% for SMEs; 95% participation-exemption ('régime mère-fille') on inbound qualifying dividends. Note: French tax losses are carried forward indefinitely with an annual cap of €1 million plus 50% of the excess taxable profit; carryback is limited to one year (temporary three-year carryback for fiscal years 2024-2025); the structured field below retains the legacy five-year flag and must be read with this note.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2065-SD (income tax return) with 2050-2059 annex schedules; filed electronically via EFI/EDI on impots.gouv.fr using the EDI-TDFC professional channel.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual; accompanied by quarterly prepayment instalments (Form 2571-SD) due 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Within three months of the fiscal year-end (Art. 223-1 CGI); for a calendar-year company, the filing date is the second business day after 1 May.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Enter SIREN number, legal form (SARL), registered office, share capital and activity code corresponding to ISIC 7110 (French NAF/APE 7112B - engineering and technical studies).
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Identify the non-resident shareholder on the accompanying Schedule 2072-SD; the company itself remains resident and files the full return; non-resident status of shareholders does not change the company's filing box.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Report gross turnover, exclusive of VAT, derived from offshore CAD/BIM and structural drafting services invoiced to foreign clients.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: If the French entity is a branch of a non-resident company, report only French-source service revenue and attach the branch's separate statement; payments received by the branch are not subject to Art. 182 B withholding.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: State the fiscal result after deduction of operating costs, depreciation, and the application of carryforward losses and tax credits.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident without a French permanent establishment that earns French-source engineering fees must file a limited return (Form 2065-RS) and apply treaty relief through the Art. 182 B withholding procedure.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Detail the opening balance of losses, current-year loss, losses absorbed against current profit, and the closing balance to be carried forward.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident branch losses are available only against the French branch's future profits and must be reflected in the branch's own accounts.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Claim the Research Tax Credit for qualifying BIM software development and modelling R&D; attach the technical statement of eligible expenditure.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: CIR is refundable to non-residents only if the qualifying research is physically conducted in France through a French permanent establishment.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late filing (Art. 1728 CGI): 10% automatic increase on tax due, with a minimum flat penalty of €150 where no tax is due; a formal notice triggers an additional 0.20% per month late-payment interest; bad-faith omission attracts a 40% increase; fraudulent manoeuvres attract an 80% increase; after 30 days of notice the tax becomes immediately enforceable.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: Form 2571-SD (quarterly prepayment notice) filed through the professional EDI/EFI portal.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: Instalments due on 15 March, 15 June, 15 September and 15 December of the fiscal year; balancing payment due at the filing of Form 2065-SD.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Compute each instalment based on the previous year's tax (or estimated basis for a new SARL) less the research tax credit set-off.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A non-resident branch files the same instalment form under its French SIREN; treaty-exempt income is excluded from the instalment base.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late or omitted instalments attract 0.20% monthly late-payment interest and a 5% increase applied from the due date (Art. 1731 CGI).

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: Statutory withholding tax of 25% on dividends distributed to non-resident legal entities (Art. 119 bis CGI); 12.8% withholding for non-resident individuals (Art. 117 quater CGI); 0% for qualifying EU parent companies holding at least 10% of the SARL's capital for two years under the Parent-Subsidiary Directive implemented by Art. 119 ter CGI.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: The non-resident beneficiary must obtain a Tax Residence Certificate (TRC) from its local tax authority and deliver it to the French paying SARL before the distribution; the paying company then applies the treaty rate at source, e.g. 10% dividends under the France-China DTA or reduced rates under other DTAs. Where the standard rate has already been withheld, the beneficiary must claim a refund within two years of payment using Form 5002/5003 filed with the local French tax office (SIE); the French SARL, as withholding agent, files Form 2561 and retains the TRC in its books to support the reduced rate.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Royalties: statutory withholding of 33⅓% on patent, software and IP royalties paid to non-residents (Art. 182 B bis CGI); treaty rates commonly reduce this to 10% under the France-China DTA, with 0% available for qualifying EU associated companies under the Interest and Royalties Directive. Interest: ordinary arm's-length debt interest is generally free of domestic French withholding tax; DTA ceilings typically cap interest at 10% (France-China); deductible interest remains subject to the thin-capitalisation and interest limitation rules of Art. 212 CGI (30% EBITDA cap and €3 million safe-harbour).

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: Mandatory Master File and Local File under Art. L.13 AA of the French Tax Procedure Code where the French entity or the group records annual turnover or gross balance-sheet assets above €400 million; Country-by-Country reporting is required for groups with consolidated revenue of at least €750 million. For smaller CAD/BIM service SARLs below these thresholds, no statutory TP file is mandatory, but on audit the burden of proof shifts to the taxpayer when contemporaneous arm's-length documentation is absent, exposing the company to the Art. 1740 ter CGI penalty of 5% of reassessed profits (minimum €10,000).
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: France has not enacted UAE-style Economic Substance Regulations; substance is enforced through the general anti-abuse rule (Art. L.64 of the French Tax Procedure Code), EU ATAD CFC rules (Art. 209 B CGI), anti-hybrid rules, and the OECD treaty-shopping framework. A French SARL performing genuine CAD/BIM drafting, employing local engineers, holding a local bank account, maintaining board minutes and bearing operational risk satisfies the substance requirement; a hollow conduit without employees and premises is rebuttable as an abuse of law and may trigger an 80% penalty.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Deliberate concealment of turnover derived from CAD/BIM services, creation of fictitious or inflated invoices, omission of assets or sales from the Form 2065-SD return, or systematic diversion of profits to offshore accounts without economic justification.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal conviction under Art. 1741 CGI: fine up to €500,000 per offender (up to €3 million in aggravated circumstances) and imprisonment from one to five years (seven years where the offence involves organised crime); civil tax consequences include reassessment with 40% bad-faith or 80% fraud increases plus late-payment interest at 0.20% per month.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors who sign or cause the filing of false returns are jointly and severally liable for the tax and penalties under Art. 1840 CGI; criminal courts may impose travel bans, confiscation of assets, and imprisonment; directors may also face civil restitution to the Treasury and disqualification from corporate management.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Operating the SARL as an empty corporate vehicle with no employees, premises, local decision-making or operating risk, used exclusively to route intra-group CAD/BIM fees or to claim treaty benefits on outbound dividends.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Disallowance of the arrangement under the abuse-of-law procedure (Art. L.64 LPF) leading to reassessment of hidden profits as dividends (Art. 111 c CGI), application of an 80% penalty (100% where the abuse was concealed), and imposition of the 25% dividend withholding tax on the deemed distribution.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The managing director is personally and severally liable for the abuse-of-law penalty under Art. 1840 CGI; directors may incur commercial disqualification, personal insolvency proceedings, and criminal liability if the shell arrangement served to launder tax fraud proceeds.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Invoicing CAD/BIM services to the French SARL at margins deviating from arm's-length standards without maintaining a contemporaneous Local File and Master File, or refusing to produce the documentation upon a tax audit request.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Reassessment of the hidden profit transfer with a 5% penalty on the reassessed amount (minimum €10,000) under Art. 1740 ter CGI, plus a 40% bad-faith increase; the burden of proof shifts to the taxpayer when documentation is absent, and the hidden profit may be recharacterised as a constructive dividend subject to withholding tax.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: The director who signed the deficient return or approved the non-arm's-length pricing may be held jointly liable for the penalty under Art. 1840 CGI; failure to implement OECD-compliant documentation can expose directors to professional negligence claims and regulatory sanctions.

fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.triggering_act: Failure to register the SARL's beneficial owner in the French RBE register, concealment of the ultimate controlling party through nominee arrangements, or routing of payments through sanctioned jurisdictions or opaque offshore accounts.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.statutory_sanction: Criminal sanctions under the Monetary and Financial Code (Art. L.561-1 and following): up to five years' imprisonment and a €375,000 fine for individuals, and a €1,875,000 fine for the company; Tracfin reporting obligations apply; banking relationships may be frozen and the corporate registration suspended.
fatal_compliance_red_flags_and_liabiliti.personal_liability_of_directors: Directors face imprisonment for money-laundering of tax fraud proceeds, travel bans, asset seizure, and civil liability to the Treasury; directors may be prohibited from managing commercial companies for up to 15 years.
